profile.name: Minji Kim
profile.oneLineIntro: Hands-on builder who connects robots, code and healthcare — from Arduino gadgets to gesture-recognition ML.

entries.rawNote: weekend hackathon with 3 teammates, we made a medication reminder web app prototype in react for elderly people
entries.cvBullet: Co-developed a React medication-reminder web app prototype for elderly users with 3 teammates during a weekend hackathon.

entries.rawNote: signals and systems assignment: filtered EMG sample data with numpy, removed noise with a band-pass filter
entries.cvBullet: Filtered sample EMG signals with a NumPy band-pass filter to remove noise in a Signals and Systems assignment.

entries.rawNote: became PR lead of the robotics club, made the poster and instagram posts for the fall recruiting
entries.cvBullet: Led PR for the robotics club as PR lead, designing the poster and Instagram posts for fall recruiting.

entries.rawNote: attended a medical robotics seminar at DGIST about rehabilitation exoskeletons, really interesting
entries.cvBullet: Attended a DGIST seminar on medical robotics focused on rehabilitation exoskeletons.

entries.rawNote: finished an online ROS beginner course during summer break, built turtlesim nodes in ubuntu
entries.cvBullet: Completed an online ROS beginner course, building turtlesim nodes on Ubuntu Linux.

entries.rawNote: started ML mini project classifying hand gestures with webcam, using opencv and a small pytorch cnn, 5 gestures
entries.cvBullet: Developed a webcam-based classifier for 5 hand gestures using OpenCV and a small PyTorch CNN.

entries.rawNote: volunteer coding class for local middle school students, taught scratch basics to about 15 kids
entries.cvBullet: Taught Scratch programming basics to about 15 local middle-school students as a volunteer instructor.

entries.rawNote: robotics club competition today, our line-following robot got 3rd place out of 12 teams!
entries.cvBullet: Won 3rd place out of 12 teams in a robotics club competition with a line-following robot.

entries.rawNote: wrote intro to biology lab report on cell imaging, used fluorescence microscope and counted cells in imagej
entries.cvBullet: Imaged cells with a fluorescence microscope and quantified cell counts in ImageJ for an Intro to Biology lab report.

entries.rawNote: made a plant watering thing with arduino for club, works with moisture sensor
entries.cvBullet: Built an Arduino-based automatic plant-watering system using a soil-moisture sensor for the robotics club.

entries.rawNote: started a linear algebra study group with 5 friends, i organize the weekly meetings and problem sets
entries.cvBullet: Founded and organized a weekly 6-member linear algebra study group, preparing problem sets for each session.

entries.rawNote: finished python data analysis assignment for intro to programming, cleaned the daegu weather dataset with pandas and made plots
entries.cvBullet: Cleaned and analyzed a Daegu weather dataset with Python (pandas) and visualized trends for an Intro to Programming assignment.
